subject: crescent-headed walker puppet
art_direction: 瓦楞纸月牙头机械偶套着布褶身，细木腿大脚掌，向上看得很认真。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Build a puppet with a broad crescent-shaped cardboard head, its inner curve holding a small attentive face. A pleated cotton cylinder forms the torso, above thin wooden legs and oversized flat feet. Turn the head upward while the feet stand slightly apart. Use exposed corrugation at the head edge, mustard cloth, and muted blue paint on the feet. Keep the materials visibly handmade and the silhouette balanced against cream paper. Do not add strings, a theater stage, stars, space helmets, or a toy brand likeness. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
